# wso2is_tenant (Resource)

Manages a tenant (a root organization) and its owner.

The provider that creates the tenant must manage the super tenant (`tenant_domain = "carbon.super"`). It must use basic authentication, with a user who may manage tenants. With an application's client credentials, the server fails to create the tenant (`TM-65002`, "Error in adding claims to the user").

To manage objects inside the tenant, add another provider block with an `alias`. Set `tenant_domain = wso2is_tenant.<name>.domain`, and sign in as the owner (`username = "<owner>@<domain>"`). This works in the same configuration.

When you destroy the resource, the provider deletes the tenant if the server allows it (`[tenant_mgt] tenant_deletion = true` in `deployment.toml`). Otherwise, the provider deactivates the tenant and shows a warning. To import, use the tenant ID or domain.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# The super tenant's administrator creates tenants. This needs basic authentication.
provider "wso2is" {
  username = "admin"
  password = var.super_admin_password
}

resource "wso2is_tenant" "acme" {
  domain           = "acme.com"
  owner_username   = "admin"
  owner_password   = var.acme_admin_password
  owner_email      = "it@acme.com"
  owner_first_name = "Acme"
  owner_last_name  = "Admin"
}

# A second provider block manages the new tenant. It signs in as the tenant owner.
provider "wso2is" {
  alias         = "acme"
  tenant_domain = wso2is_tenant.acme.domain
  username      = "${wso2is_tenant.acme.owner_username}@${wso2is_tenant.acme.domain}"
  password      = var.acme_admin_password
}

resource "wso2is_group" "acme_staff" {
  provider = wso2is.acme
  name     = "staff"
}

variable "super_admin_password" {
  type      = string
  sensitive = true
}

variable "acme_admin_password" {
  type      = string
  sensitive = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `domain` (String) Tenant domain, for example `acme.com`. Changing it replaces the tenant.
- `owner_email` (String) Email of the tenant owner.
- `owner_password` (String, Sensitive) The tenant owner's password. The server never returns it, so the provider cannot notice changes made outside Terraform.
- `owner_username` (String) Username of the tenant owner (without the domain). Changing it replaces the tenant.

### Optional

- `activated` (Boolean) Whether the tenant is active. Deactivated tenants cannot be used to sign in. The default is `true`.
- `name` (String) Display name. The default is the domain. The server only accepts this value at creation.
- `owner_first_name` (String) First name of the tenant owner.
- `owner_last_name` (String) Last name of the tenant owner.

### Read-Only

- `created_date` (String) Creation time (ISO-8601).
- `id` (String) Tenant ID.
- `owner_id` (String) User ID of the tenant owner.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import wso2is_tenant.acme acme.com
```
